character.name: Elven Assault Trooper
character.description: These shooters are the mundane elite of the Peace Force Constables, not quite as good as Ghosts, but the best the law enforce-ment branch has to offer. Filling the same role as Fast Response Teams or SWAT in a Lone Star town, they’re the big guns that can be brought to bear when full-on Ghosts might not be available.
